crossRefs.note: He said, “No; but I have come now as commander of Yahweh’s army.” Joshua fell on his face to the earth, and worshiped…
Yahweh said to Joshua, “Behold, I have given Jericho into your hand, with its king and the mighty men of valor.
Yahweh said to Joshua, “Get up! Why have you fallen on your face like that?
Now Joshua was old and well advanced in years. Yahweh said to him, “You are old and advanced in years, and there…
